title: Endpoint directory response
description: The reply to a trust-gated endpoint-directory query. It lists ONLY endpoints that are simultaneously enabled, actively leased, advertise:true, and admissible for the querying peer. Endpoint identifiers only — no display name, avatar, role, prompt, client kind, payload schema, or permission claim (ADR-0031). Results are advisory and short-lived; a caller may send to an out-of-band EndpointId without querying first.

endpoints.description: At most 32. More than 32 entries, invalid grammar, or duplicates are ProtocolViolation on receipt. A valid but unsorted unique list is sorted locally rather than rejected.

ttl_ms.description: Clamped locally to the 5-minute hard ceiling. Freshness starts at LOCAL RECEIPT, not at generated_at_ms.

generated_at_ms.description: Diagnostic only. Never used for freshness — it is remote-controlled.
